shape.description: A 1-D integer Tensor or Python array. The shape of the output samples to be drawn per alpha/beta-parameterized distribution.

alpha.description: A Tensor or Python value or N-D array of type `dtype`. `alpha` provides the shape parameter(s) describing the gamma distribution(s) to sample. Must be broadcastable with `beta`.

beta.description: A Tensor or Python value or N-D array of type `dtype`. Defaults to 1. `beta` provides the inverse scale parameter(s) of the gamma distribution(s) to sample. Must be broadcastable with `alpha`. dtype: The type of alpha, beta, and the output: `float16`, `float32`, or `float64`.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed for the distributions. See `tf.random.set_seed` for behavior.

output.description: a `Tensor` of shape `tf.concat([shape, tf.shape(alpha + beta)], axis=0)` with values of type `dtype`.
